title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: Context/motivation: Add authoritative RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and concise tool-calling quickstarts to the docs site to accelerate developer onboarding and reduce support questions. This PR provides opinionated templates for common RAG workflows (kb ingestion + retrieval + agent orchestration), step-by-step quickstarts for tool-calling using the Redwood agent SDK (Python + TypeScript), example notebooks, and docs-site navigation updates so the new content is discoverable. Checklist: - [x] add rag templates under redwood-examples/rag-templates - [x] add step-by-step quickstart guides in docs/guides/agents/tool-calling - [x] include runnable Python and TypeScript samples and minimal Dockerfiles - [x] update website sidebar and quickstart index - [x] add docs-site Playwright smoke test and CI job - [x] update changelog/release notes. What changed (summary): Added three RAG templates (kb-vectorstore, kb-elasticsearch, kb-s3) with README and minimal ingestion scripts; added two quickstarts (python-agent-tool-calling.md, ts-agent-tool-calling.md) with copy-paste code, expected outputs, and troubleshooting tips; updated docs site sidebar (website/sidebars.js) to surface the new guides; added example interactive snippets for the docs playground; added a Playwright test to validate the quickstart tutorial renders and the included code block copy buttons work; minor styling adjustments to the code block theme to improve readability. Testing: Local docs build (yarn build) + yarn start for preview; ran Playwright smoke tests locally and in CI; verified example notebooks execute end-to-end in a small test harness using a mocked embedding/retrieval backend; validated doc links and anchors. Migration/rollout notes: Non-breaking documentation-only changes; no API or runtime changes. Release notes: "Docs: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts (ENG-1145, DOC-78)". Related: ENG-1145 for templates and DOC-78 for docs site UX improvements. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/73210 (internal preview).
